hints.title: Filter Connected Friend Pairs
hints.text: Find friendships where the two friends share no common language; pairs that already share a language need no instruction.

hints.title: Identify Target Users
hints.text: Collect all unique users who participate in at least one uncommunicative friendship.

hints.title: Minimize Instruction Across Languages
hints.text: For each language 1 to n, count how many of these target users do not speak it, and return the minimum.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: U is users in broken friendships
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all combinations of languages to teach explores exponential subsets.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Teaching only one optimal language across the disconnected friendship subset takes polynomial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes that only one common language needs to be chosen globally.
